stem: Which sentence can replace sentence 2 to improve the introduction to this letter?

options.label: A
options.text: There are many clubs at my school that I want to tell you a little about in this letter.

options.label: B
options.text: My friends and I have recently formed a club devoted to community service.

options.label: C
options.text: Our school has a club, and it is a great place to learn about working with others.

options.label: D
options.text: I’m in a club that meets on Tuesdays after school in the library next to the gym.
